name: Diploma in Radiography
title: Diploma in Radiography (X-Ray Technology)
intro: The two-year diploma route: eligibility, admission, course, clinical training and certification.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: PCB or PCM is generally required.
points: Class 12 Science with Physics is important.
Minimum marks are usually 40–50%.
Some institutes accept other streams, so check.
Learn the basics of anatomy and radiation.

phases.title: Admission process
points: Apply to the state paramedical board or institute.
Check recognition of the institute.
Submit documents.
Pay fees and confirm.

phases.title: Two years of training
phases.summary: Radiographic anatomy, positioning and X-ray technology.
points: Year 1: Anatomy, Physiology, Radiation Physics, Patient Care.
Year 2: Radiographic Techniques, Positioning, Darkroom/Digital imaging, Radiation Protection.
Practical sessions form a significant portion.
Final exams cover theory and practical skills.

phases.title: Clinical internship
points: Position patients under supervision and produce diagnostic images.
Follow radiation safety rules and dose protocols.
Maintain a logbook.
Obtain an internship certificate.

phases.title: Careers and upgrading
points: Jobs: X-ray technician, radiographer at hospitals, diagnostic centres and clinics.
Upgrade through BSc in Radiology and Imaging Technology.
Government jobs through state and central recruitment.
Safety certification follows AERB guidance.
